status.en: 45 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Kordofan, Darfur and Khartoum.
status.nb: 45 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Kordofan, Darfur og Khartoum.

summary.en: The Rapid Support Forces have intensified drone strikes, hitting a market in Abyei and killing more than 150 civilians, and have deliberately bombed hospitals in el-Fasher, further limiting medical care. Drought and El Niño are worsening famine risk across war-torn Sudan, adding environmental pressure to the conflict. The United Nations is resuming peace efforts aimed at ending the drone war and easing the humanitarian crisis. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: RSF-militsen har økt antall droneangrep, rammet et marked i Abyei og drept mer enn 150 sivile, og har bevisst bombet sykehus i el-Fasher, noe som ytterligere begrenser helsehjelpen. Tørke og El Niño forverrer sultrisikoen i det krigsherjede Sudan, og legger et ekstra miljømessig press på konflikten. FN gjenopptar fredsarbeidet med mål om å avslutte dronekrigen og dempe den humanitære krisen. 4 680 drepte i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
